title: Open letter to all Hatchers! 🐣 The time is now to design our Commons!

posts.cooked:
Hey Hatchers!

We TEC Hatchers have come far together.

The Commons Upgrade is just around the corner! The upgrade will transform the TEC Hatch DAO into a full fledged Commons with an Augmented Bonding Curve and a Conviction Voting governance system. Now is the time to collectively parameterize our Commons economy while also learning more about DAO design and token economics. These decisions are yours, friends.

The Commons Configuration Dashboard is live!

Go ahead a take a look around the Commons Configuration Dashboard on your own or join a party.

Screen Shot 2021-11-03 at 9.43.32 AM997×687 117 KB

The parties are back!

So how can you get involved? We have a calendar full of parties where you will be guided every step of the way to submitting your own parameter proposal. The parties are hosted by someone that will answer questions about the dashboard or Commons upgrade process, and explain in more detail each of the parameters. From the Token Freeze of our Hatcher TECH tokens to the Commons Tribute of the Augmented Bonding Curve.

So, what's next?

What happens after the community has deepened their knowledge and submitted their proposals for the Augmented Bonding Curves and Conviction Voting? Then these submissions will be voted on by all Hatchers and the winning submission will be the parameter set that we deploy in the Commons upgrade.

.
The decision making process is outlined here on the Forum but the key dates to know are:

(dates have been updated!)

  • Learn & propose: Nov 7 - 18
  • Propose & debate: Nov 19 - 25
  • Debate & rock the vote: Nov 25 - 30
  • Stewards council (& creating voters pamphlet): Dec 1 -6
  • Runoff vote: Dec 13

Join the party, design our economy. 💚
